description:
Research boiling points for five solvents on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), determine their distillation recovery order (lowest to highest boiling point), and identify the 'critical pair' (the two adjacent chemicals with the smallest temperature difference). 

Chemicals to analyze:
1. Acetone
2. Toluene
3. Methyl Ethyl Ketone (2-Butanone)
4. Isopropyl Alcohol (2-Propanol)
5. Xylene (mixed isomers)

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/distillation_schedule.txt' formatted exactly as follows:

DISTILLATION RECOVERY SCHEDULE
================================

1. [Chemical Name] ([BP] C)
2. [Chemical Name] ([BP] C)
   -> Delta: [Value] C
3. [Chemical Name] ([BP] C)
   -> Delta: [Value] C
4. [Chemical Name] ([BP] C)
   -> Delta: [Value] C
5. [Chemical Name] ([BP] C)
   -> Delta: [Value] C

CRITICAL SEPARATION PAIR (Smallest Delta):
[Chemical A] and [Chemical B] (Delta: [Value] C)

Note: Use the boiling point values found in the Physical Properties section of the CAMEO datasheets. Convert any Fahrenheit values to Celsius.
